title: Original ball found but is unplayable
question: You find your original ball within 3 minutes, but it's stuck up against a tree and you can't play it. Are you allowed to keep playing your provisional ball instead?

choices.text: Yes, you can play the provisional ball instead of the original
No, you must continue with the original ball and use the unplayable ball rule
Yes, but only with a penalty stroke
You can declare both balls lost and replay your shot

explanation: You must continue with your original ball, even if it’s unplayable. If you can't play it, you have to use the options under the unplayable ball rule.
